decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is occupied.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - The use hereby permitted for a doctors surgery for two doctors purposes shall not be carried on outside the hours of 08.00 - 18.00 Monday - Friday, 09.00 - 17.00 Saturdays nor at any time on Sundays, Bank or Public Holidays.

Condition : 5 - Before first occupation of the buildings the loading, unloading and turning space, and parking spaces (including spaces for people with disabilities) shall be provided within the curtilage of the site in accordance with the scheme shown on drawing No GUG/99/326/02A and such spaces shall be permanently available and not be used for any other purpose.
Condition : 6 - The surgery shall be used by no more than two doctors at any one time without the prior approval of the local authority

Condition : 7 - The dormer window marked W9 on plans numbered TGR/2C and dated May 1995 shall be fitted with obscured glazing and retained as such before the first occupation of the first floor of this building.

Condition : 8 - Before the extensions hereby permitted are first occupied, details of the secure bin store enclosure area shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority and then implemented in accordance with these plans and retained as such.
description: Demolition of garage and lean-to, erection of single storey rear extension, single storey side extension, and roof extension to form additional storey to bungalow in connection with proposed doctors surgeries.
